Test Scenario: Create new product with valid mandatory and optional attributes

Actual Output: Product 'Apple iPad Air 11-inch' registered in MySQL database; confirmation JSON returned (HTTP 201 Created)

Expected Output: Whitespace trimmed and rejected with error: 'Product ID is required' (HTTP 400 Bad Request)
Actual Output: Whitespace-only ID rejected before database execution (HTTP 400 Bad Request)

Test Scenario: Accept product creation with maximum length Product ID (20 characters)

Test Scenario: Reject product creation when Category is empty
